title: LangGraph agent (Python)
summary: create_agent with HumanInTheLoopMiddleware for the approval gate, a checkpointer for resume, model and recursion limits, OpenTelemetry.
verified: RUN: the scaffold's tests and gold set ran here against the offline stub with langchain 1.5.2 and langgraph 1.2.24, including interrupt and resume; the image built and its gold set passed 16 of 16 inside the container with no network. Not run against a live model here. 1.3.0: runs that wait for a person kept in SQLite and answered from another process, the refund made once after a crash, and the HTTP interface, all in its tests and gold set. 1.4.0: every model call through the LiteLLM gateway with AGENT_GATEWAY=litellm, its wiring tested here against a stand-in provider, and the gold set run in the Studio's CI through the real LiteLLM 1.110.0 proxy against stand-ins, with the keys and the traces checked. Checkpoints are written before each next step, so the crash case passed 30 runs in a row. The cloud templates (qz cloud add) validated and planned for Azure, AWS, Google Cloud and Kubernetes in the Studio's CI with no cloud account; never applied.
stack_line: A LangGraph agent in Python (langchain 1.5, langgraph 1.2).
run_cmd: uv run -m agent.app "Where is my order ORD-1001?"
live: Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and AGENT_MODE=live. For OpenAI set OPENAI_API_KEY and AGENT_MODEL=openai:<model id>; for Bedrock, AWS credentials and AGENT_MODEL=bedrock_converse:<model id>.
next: Replace the two tool bodies in agent/tools.py with calls to your systems.
Rewrite evals/gold.jsonl for your use case; keep the safety and gate tags.
Set AGENT_IDENTITY=oidc (or proxy) and the AGENT_OIDC_* settings before the HTTP interface is reachable by anyone; demo identities are refused in production.

ai_act.purpose: Answers customers' questions about their orders and requests refunds; a person approves every refund before it is issued.
notice: You're chatting with an AI assistant, not a person.

open_line: Live runs default to an open-weight model on your own machine (qwen3:8b on Ollama, Apache-2.0); set AGENT_MODEL to use a vendor.

knowledge.none: answers from its tools (the order lookup), not from documents; a RAG kit joins as a tool when it needs them

endpoints.purpose: an open-weight model on the same machine (Ollama), or the model gateway beside the agent (AGENT_GATEWAY=litellm): every model call goes through it
endpoints.processor: none for Ollama; for the gateway, the gateway runs where the agent runs; the providers it forwards to are named in gateway/litellm.yaml
